label: prose:eigenspace-invariance-intro
title: Eigenspace invariance and observable spectra
html: When the photon–electron transfer matrix T_{\gamma e} is evaluated across a spatially varying local modulus q_{\mathrm{local}}(t), the variance of the Reeb flow broadens the radiative transition pathways while preserving the relative ratios of the Wedderburn eigenspaces. The following theorem proves that gauge conformal invariance protects the higher-order emission pole ratios against distortion under local shifts of q.
